_comment: Air fryer times. Every row is copied from a named source: a Ninja quick start guide chart, Ninja UK's own table, or the maker's printed pack instructions as shown on the linked product page. Pack rows keep the pack's own quantity. Do not add a row without a source.

ninja-af200uk.name: Ninja, Foodi Dual Zone Air Fryer AF200UK Quick Start Guide (air fry cooking chart)

ninja-af100uk.name: Ninja, Air Fryer AF100UK Series Quick Start Guide (air fry cooking chart), copy hosted by ManualsLib

ninja-blog.name: Ninja Kitchen UK, Air fryer cooking times

packet.text: If a food isn't in Ninja's chart, it says to cut the cooking time on the packaging by 25%, check often and add time if needed.

quantity.text: Cook a smaller amount for less time and a larger amount for longer, and check often.

layer.text: For even browning, spread food in an even layer with no overlapping.

shake.text: Shake the food at least twice during cooking.

check.text: Start checking 2 minutes before the time is up, and make sure food has reached a safe temperature.

foods.name: Homemade chips
foods.intro: Ninja's chart says to soak the cut chips in cold water for at least 30 minutes, then pat them dry. The drier they are, the better they crisp.

foods.name: Roast potatoes
foods.intro: Ninja's table doesn't say whether the potatoes are parboiled first, or how many. For frozen roasties, see the frozen roast potatoes page.
